children: Bengaluru: OnEMI Technology Solutions, which operates digital lending platform Kissht, is looking to raise fresh capital, about four months after its initial public offering through which it raised 850 crore in primary capital. The company's board will meet on September 17 to consider raising funds through equity shares, warrants, convertible instruments or other eligible securities through a preferential issue, private placement or a combination of permissible routes, according to a regulatory filing on Monday. The proposal will require shareholder and other statutory approvals. The filing did not disclose the size of the proposed fundraise, the investors who may participate, or the intended use of the proceeds. These details are typically finalised when the board approves the transaction.- Our Bureau

title: Kissht Operator OnEMI Plans to Raise Capital 4 Mths After IPO
